happy: PlantFam buddy, MOOD = HAPPY. Plant: a baby rubber plant (Peperomia obtusifolia): a compact, bushy, upright mound of thick, fleshy, very glossy, rounded-oval (spoon-shaped) leaves in deep green, each leaf held on a short, thick, succulent pale-green stem. Leaves are smooth with almost no visible veins and a strong waxy shine. No variegation, no flowers, no trailing stems. Small and neat, about as wide as it is tall. Pot: sky blue #5AB8FF.
